name: Restoration and Enhancement (R&E) Fund
summary: Calls for proposals funding restoration and enhancement of Yukon River salmon stocks and habitat, including stock restoration, sonar and stewardship projects.

steps: Proposal and project budget form via grantee portal
Panel review, with questions or recommendations to proponents

applicant_types.quote: Private, non-profit, and public sector applicants are encouraged to apply.

access.quote: Applications forms can be accessed and submitted via the grantee portal submission form.

window.quote: The Yukon River Panel is issuing this Call for Proposals for projects beginning in 2027.

effort.quote: Applications forms can be accessed and submitted via the grantee portal submission form.
Completed applications (including proposals and budget forms) must be submitted by 11:59 p.m. PT on Monday, November 2, 2026.

The review of all Project Proposals by the Panel will begin at the 2026 Post-Season meeting. Any Panel questions or recommendations regarding Project Proposals will be provided to project proponents following this meeting.

eligibility.quote: Applicants that have received support from the Restoration and Enhancement (R&E) Fund must be in good standing to be eligible for further support

documents.quote: Completed applications (including proposals and budget forms) must be submitted by 11:59 p.m. PT on Monday, November 2, 2026.

eligibility.rule: Past R&E Fund grantees are in good standing
